title: Full-suite gate fails in run worktrees: TestTheBuiltBinaryExitsTwo exits 1, not 2
body: internal/cli's TestTheBuiltBinaryExitsTwo builds the ticfac binary and runs `ticfac run-epic x` from internal/cli; inside this run's linked worktree the binary resolves .tick/runners.toml relative to cwd, fails with 'read the gate configuration: open .../internal/cli/.tick/runners.toml: no such file' and exits 1 instead of the expected exit 2 'no executor configured'. Reproduced byte-identically at base commit f4f5cac334c2 with my diff stashed, so it is pre-existing and environment-shaped: the binary's repo-root discovery appears not to survive a linked worktree's .git FILE (a directory in a normal checkout). Every tick worker that runs the full Go suite in its worktree will see this failure and must attribute it by hand.
